newsitem.title: USA: BAB Holdings in food court agreement.
newsitem.headline: BAB Holdings in food court agreement.

text.p: BAB Holdings Inc, which operates Big Apple Bagels, said Tuesday it signed a licensing agreement with Choice Picks Food Court, a food court concept franchised by Choice Hotels International Inc.

The agreement makes Big Apple Bagels the only bagel brand offered by Choice Picks Food Court, which offers food courts with three or more food and beverage brands together in a single location for hotels, colleges, hospitals and other food service operations.

There are 15 Choice Picks Food Court franchises operating in the United States. BAB said Choice Hotels' goal is to have 50 Choice Picks Food Courts operating by the end of the year, with a long-term goal of 500 food courts by the end of 1998.
"BAB's licensing agreement with Choice Picks Food Court will be a significant addition to our fast-growing nontraditional licensing business," Michael Evans, BAB president, said in a statement.
